description: Tunes vulnerability scanners to reduce false positives, optimize scan policies, and improve result accuracy. Covers false positive identification patterns, scan policy configuration, authenticated vs unauthenticated scanning tradeoffs, severity override criteria, plugin/check selection, scan scheduling, and result correlation across multiple scanners. Uses CVSS 4.0 for severity validation and CWE for vulnerability classification.
